title: Pitch driver-app redesign to eng
persona: Sneha, senior designer on Ola driver app
scenario: You want to redesign the driver-app home screen, the 4-tile grid that's been there since 2018. Drivers say it's noisy, eng says it's fine. You have 8 minutes in the platform review with a notoriously skeptical eng lead. You need a pitch that leads with the user pain (not the design vision), shows one concrete before/after, names the smallest possible scope to ship, and pre-empts the 3 objections eng will raise.
badPrompt: help me pitch a redesign of the ola driver app home screen
badOutput:
Pitch: Redesign Driver App Home

The current home screen is outdated. A new design will improve usability, reduce cognitive load, and align with our brand. Benefits include faster task completion, better satisfaction, and a more modern look.

hints.title: Lead with pain, not vision
hints.body: ‘Open with one driver quote or one metric, not with the redesign idea.’ Skeptical eng leads tune out vision-first pitches.

hints.title: Pre-empt objections
hints.body: ‘List the 3 objections eng will raise and answer them in advance.’ Adversarial prompting kills the back-and-forth before it starts.

checks.tip: Frame the artifact, a pitch, not a design doc.
Anchor the surface, driver-app home, 4-tile grid.
Reference the audience, skeptical eng lead, 8-minute slot.
Anchor the current state and user pain, drivers say it's noisy.
Demand the smallest shippable scope, eng leads care about cost.
Demand the 3 objections eng will raise, with answers.
Demand one concrete before/after, not abstract claims.
Lock the length, 8-minute pitch, otherwise it sprawls.
Specify the order, pain → before/after → scope → objections.

tipIfLow: Pitching to skeptical eng fails when designers lead with vision. The unlock is pain-first + smallest-scope + pre-empted objections. Adversarial framing, ‘what will eng say no to first’, is the difference between a yes and a 4-week debate.
goldPrompt: Act as a pitch-writing partner. I'm Sneha, senior designer on Ola driver app. I have 8 minutes with a notoriously skeptical eng lead to pitch a redesign of the home-screen 4-tile grid. Open with one driver quote OR one usage metric, NOT with the redesign. Show one before/after of a single tile. State the smallest possible scope to ship in 2 weeks. Then list the 3 objections eng will raise (likely: backend API change, A/B test cost, regression risk) and answer each in advance with one sentence. Output as a 1-pager. Cap at 200 words.
